title: Moravians
fact_summary: A people and realm on the eastern border of Bavaria, ruled by Zwentibald until 894. The Frankish annals show the Hungarians first as allies against them.

claims.text: Under 892 the Annals of Fulda say Duke Zwentibald refused to come to the king, who then invaded “the land of the Moravians” with three armies, joined by Hungarians.
claims.certainty_reason: This records what the source says. The passage was read in Latin in the scanned edition linked under Sources; the English is Claude's own rendering.

claims.text: Under 894 they record Zwentibald's death, calling him “duke of the Moravians and sheath of all treachery”, and a peace between Bavarians and Moravians that autumn.
claims.certainty_reason: This records what the source says. The passage was read in Latin in the scanned edition linked under Sources; the English is Claude's own rendering.

claims.text: Under 900 the Bavarians raid the Moravian kingdom for three weeks; under 901 Moravian envoys make peace at Regensburg.
claims.certainty_reason: This records what the source says. The passage was read in Latin in the scanned edition linked under Sources; the English is Claude's own rendering.

open_questions.text: What became of the Moravian realm after 901? The annals read so far stop there.

review.note: Checked by Claude against open copies of every source. Marc spot-checks a sample.
